text.aria-label: Title text 'The simple XGBoost model trails the GAM stack at some signed-MW Primaries and beats it at most MVA-only ones'
text.tspan: The simple XGBoost model trails the GAM stack at some signed-MW Primaries and
beats it at most MVA-only ones

text.aria-label: Subtitle text 'Weekly bundle minus the GAM stack, CRPS at days 1 to 10 on the shared half-hours of 2025-07 to 2026-06. Negative is better for the XGBoost model. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval per Primary and 99% interval for pooled rows, from resampling whole months. D15 and D18 are report only.'
text.tspan: Weekly bundle minus the GAM stack, CRPS at days 1 to 10 on the shared half-hours of 2025-07 to 2026-06.
Negative is better for the XGBoost model. Dot: estimate. Line: 95% interval per Primary and 99% interval
for pooled rows, from resampling whole months. D15 and D18 are report only.
